_doc: Pexels image overrides — pass curation 1. Per-slot override of query / pinned photo_id / avoid_terms / editorial_notes. NEVER contains the API key (which lives only in env). Read by apps/core/pexels.py at fetch time. Backward-compatible with SITE_IMAGE_SLOTS: missing entries fall back to the slot default.
